scope: 4D's Query editor (QUERY with no criteria), published by the native plugin alone from the layers of its internal runtime form: each criterion's conjunction, field, comparison and value, the field list as buttons over its drawn lines, the line, destination and options buttons, and Query and Cancel; operated by ordinary clicks and keys; by AX and by VoiceOver
fixture: prepare_query_editor_fixture.py and test_query_editor_fixture.py (Orders table with text, number, Boolean and date fields and five records)
checks: the Query editor is pixel-identical to the plugin-free editor
a criterion is published as its field, comparison and value
its line buttons, destination and options are labelled
Query and Cancel are buttons with their titles
the field list publishes the table's fields as buttons
the field list starts on the line's current field
pressing a field in the list makes it the criterion's field
the comparison opens 4D's own menu of comparisons for a text field
writing the value types it into 4D's own field
Add line adds a criterion, joined with And
the conjunction is chosen from its menu
the second criterion is built the same way
Remove line removes only its criterion
Query runs the query the criteria describe
VoiceOver reaches the Query editor
VoiceOver reads the criterion's field as a pop-up button
VO-Space opens the field list on the current field
VO-Space on a field in the list chooses it
VoiceOver reaches the comparison
the comparison is chosen from its menu with the arrow keys and Return
VoiceOver reaches the value
keys typed at the value enter it in 4D's own field
VoiceOver reaches the Query button
VO-Space on Query runs the query the criteria describe
voiceOverSpeech: 4D Query in [Orders] dialog Query in [Orders] Query options pop up button
Create new selection Destination pop up button

regressions.test_native_messages.py: 37 checks interpreted, compiled and under Rosetta, and 32 with VoiceOver, on the shared internal-form overlay
